paper_allele_or_genotype: paper A/G -> forward T/C; minor T enriched in males (OR 1.994)

note: v1 weights only heterozygotes (C/T, plus non-existent C/G) for all sexes; T/T gets 0. No formal replication in German/Dutch cohorts.

paper_allele_or_genotype: GSTZ1 rs2111699 GG (recessive)
paper_direction: GG favours survival at very old age
quote: It seems to act in a recessive manner, with the rs2111699-G allele favoring survival at very old age.
note: HAGR says "G allele carriers" (dominant), but the paper says recessive (two copies). v1 additive.

paper_allele_or_genotype: MAP3K7 rs282070 C (dominant); variation listed G/C
paper_direction: C carriers increased chance of longevity
quote: the rs282070-C allele positively affecting longevity in a dominant manner
note: C/G palindromic and paper gives no frequencies. Listing order G/C matches forward major/minor (EUR G=0.73), suggesting forward C, but this is unproven. v1 additive C vs paper dominant.

paper_allele_or_genotype: TOMM40 rs2075650 G
paper_direction: G-allele carriage lower in long-lived offspring (unfavourable)
quote: The likelihood of carrying an APOE ε4 allele or a G allele in rs2075650 was lower
note: v1 G risk matches.

paper_allele_or_genotype: TAS2R16 rs978739 A/A (A = forward T; minus strand)
paper_direction: A/A frequency rises from 35% to 55% in centenarians
quote: the frequency of A/A homozygotes increases gradually from 35% in subjects aged 20 to 70 up to 55% in centenarians
note: v1 T/T only (recessive) matches the A/A finding.

paper_allele_or_genotype: SIRT3 rs11555236 minor T (= forward A); HR het 1.18, hom 0.58

note: Direction matches; heterozygote HR 1.18 (>1), so v1 het +0.33 is not supported.

paper_allele_or_genotype: SIRT3 rs4980329 minor A (= forward T); HR GA 1.08, AA 0.66

quote: The calculated HRs, considering the major allele homozygous genotype as reference, were 1.08 and 0.66 for (GA) and (AA) genotypes
note: Direction matches; het weight unsupported.
